name: week
title: Weekly process review
subtitle: Approved procedures, overdue work and pending acknowledgements

sections.title: Reviews due within 30 days
sections.sql: select reference,name,owner,review_due,days_to_review,overdue_improvements from process_register where status='active' and (review_due is null or review_due<=current_date+30) order by review_due

sections.title: Open improvements
sections.sql: select reference,process,title,owner,due,priority from improvement_queue order by due

sections.title: Read receipts missing for current version
sections.sql: select reference,name,version,reader from acknowledgement_gaps order by reference,reader

sections.title: Record exceptions
sections.sql: select reference,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by reference,rule

sections.title: Time and unresolved priorities
sections.sql: select * from process_bottlenecks order by wait_minutes desc
